```{python}
#| include: false
import html
import json
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

# dashboard/tiles.py: the tile contract (tiles.yml) + dbt model reader.
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent))
import tiles

CATEGORIES = tiles.categories("issue_category")
CATEGORY_SCALE = {"domain": CATEGORIES, "range": [tiles.color("issue_category", c) for c in CATEGORIES]}
CATEGORY_LEGEND = {"title": None, "orient": "top",
                   "labelExpr": json.dumps({c: tiles.label("issue_category", c) for c in CATEGORIES}) + "[datum.label]"}


def rows(tile_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    """A tile's model rows, in tiles.yml order, JSON-safe for Vega-Lite."""
    return json.loads(pd.DataFrame(tiles.tile_rows(tile_id)).to_json(orient="records", date_format="iso"))


def chart(spec: dict) -> HTML:
    element_id = f"vl-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    spec = {"$schema": "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v6.json", "width": "container", "height": 280, **spec}
    spec.setdefault("config", {}).update({"view": {"stroke": None}, "axis": {"labelFontSize": 11, "titleFontWeight": "normal"}})
    return HTML(
        f'<div id="{element_id}" style="width:100%"></div>'
        f"<script>(function render() {{"
        f"if (window.vegaEmbed) {{ vegaEmbed('#{element_id}', {json.dumps(spec)}, {{actions: false}}); return; }}"
        f"setTimeout(render, 50);"
        f"}})();</script>"
    )


def category_bar(tile_id: str, y: str, total: str) -> HTML:
    """Horizontal issue_count bar stacked by issue_category, sorted by the model's total."""
    data = rows(tile_id)
    order = list(dict.fromkeys(r[y] for r in data))  # order_by: {total} desc
    return chart({
        "data": {"values": data},
        "height": {"step": 22},
        "mark": "bar",
        "encoding": {
            "y": {"field": y, "type": "nominal", "sort": order, "title": None},
            "x": {"field": "issue_count", "type": "quantitative", "stack": True, "title": "Open issues"},
            "color": {"field": "issue_category", "type": "nominal", "sort": CATEGORIES,
                      "scale": CATEGORY_SCALE, "legend": CATEGORY_LEGEND},
            "order": {"field": "category_rank"},
            "tooltip": [{"field": y}, {"field": "issue_category", "title": "Type"},
                        {"field": "issue_count", "title": "Issues"}, {"field": total, "title": "Total"}],
        },
        "transform": [{"calculate": f"indexof({json.dumps(CATEGORIES)}, datum.issue_category)", "as": "category_rank"}],
    })


def _cell(value, kind=None) -> str:
    if value is None or value != value:
        return "—"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "yes" if value else ""
    if kind == "pct":
        fill = tiles.MANIFEST["palette"]["single_series"]
        return (f'<div class="pct-bar"><div class="track"><div class="fill" '
                f'style="width:{value:.0f}%;background:{fill}"></div></div>{value:.0f}%</div>')
    return html.escape(str(value))


def issue_table(tile_id: str, headers: dict, kinds: dict | None = None) -> HTML:
    """The tile's contract columns, in order; the first column links to issue_url."""
    t = tiles.tile(tile_id)
    cols, kinds = t["columns"], kinds or {}
    head = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(headers.get(c, c))}</th>" for c in cols)
    body = []
    for r in tiles.tile_rows(tile_id):
        cells = [f'<a href="{html.escape(r[t["link"]])}" target="_blank">#{r[cols[0]]}</a>']
        cells += [_cell(r[c], kinds.get(c)) for c in cols[1:]]
        body.append("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{c}</td>" for c in cells) + "</tr>")
    return HTML(f'<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table table-sm table-hover issues">'
                f'<thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>{"".join(body)}</tbody></table></div>')


meta = tiles.one(tiles.MANIFEST["meta"]["model"])  # dashboard_meta
stale = meta["days_stale"] > tiles.MANIFEST["meta"]["stale_after_days"]
kpis = {k["label"]: k for k in tiles.kpis()}  # headline_kpis, formatted per tiles.yml
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
note = tiles.freshness_note(meta)
print(f"::: {{.callout-warning}}\n{note}\n:::" if stale else f"*{note}*")
```

## Where do things stand?

```{python}
HTML('<div class="kpi-row">' + "".join(
    f'<div class="kpi"><div class="label">{html.escape(k["label"])}</div>'
    f'<div class="value">{html.escape(k["value"])}</div>'
    f'<div class="context">{html.escape(k["context"])}</div></div>'
    for k in kpis.values()
) + "</div>")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
_open, _triage = kpis["Open issues"], kpis["Awaiting triage"]
print(f"There are **{_open['value']}** open issues ({_open['context']}), "
      f"and **{_triage['value']}** of them are still waiting for triage ({_triage['context']}).")
```

## Is the backlog shrinking?

### Open issues over time
[Open at the end of each week, by type]{.tile-subtitle}

```{python}
chart({
    "data": {"values": rows("backlog_weekly")},
    "mark": {"type": "area", "line": False},
    "encoding": {
        "x": {"field": "week", "type": "temporal", "title": None},
        "y": {"field": "open_issues", "type": "quantitative", "stack": True, "title": "Open issues"},
        "color": {"field": "issue_category", "type": "nominal", "sort": CATEGORIES,
                  "scale": CATEGORY_SCALE, "legend": CATEGORY_LEGEND},
        "order": {"field": "category_rank"},
        "tooltip": [{"field": "week", "type": "temporal"}, {"field": "issue_category", "title": "Type"},
                    {"field": "open_issues", "title": "Open"}],
    },
    "transform": [{"calculate": f"indexof({json.dumps(CATEGORIES)}, datum.issue_category)", "as": "category_rank"}],
})
```

### Opened vs closed per week
[Complete weeks; when closed > opened the backlog shrank]{.tile-subtitle}

```{python}
_series = tiles.tile("weekly_flow")["series"]
chart({
    "data": {"values": rows("weekly_flow")},
    "transform": [{"fold": _series, "as": ["series", "issues"]}],
    "mark": "bar",
    "encoding": {
        "x": {"field": "week", "type": "ordinal", "title": None,
              "axis": {"labelAngle": -45, "labelExpr": "slice(datum.label, 5)"}},
        "xOffset": {"field": "series", "sort": _series},
        "y": {"field": "issues", "type": "quantitative", "title": "Issues"},
        "color": {"field": "series", "type": "nominal", "sort": _series,
                  "scale": {"domain": _series, "range": [tiles.color("flow", s) for s in _series]},
                  "legend": {"title": None, "orient": "top",
                             "labelExpr": json.dumps({s: tiles.label("flow", s) for s in _series}) + "[datum.label]"}},
        "tooltip": [{"field": "week"}, {"field": "series"}, {"field": "issues"},
                    {"field": "net_change", "title": "Net change", "format": "+d"}],
    },
})
```

## Are we keeping up with triage?

### Open issues by triage status and age
[How much is waiting, and for how long]{.tile-subtitle}

```{python}
_data = rows("triage_pipeline")  # order_by: status_order, age_bucket_order
_buckets = tiles.categories("age_bucket")
chart({
    "data": {"values": _data},
    "height": {"step": 34},
    "mark": "bar",
    "encoding": {
        "y": {"field": "status_label", "type": "nominal", "title": None,
              "sort": list(dict.fromkeys(r["status_label"] for r in _data))},
        "x": {"field": "issue_count", "type": "quantitative", "stack": True, "title": "Open issues"},
        "color": {"field": "age_bucket", "type": "ordinal", "sort": _buckets,
                  "scale": {"domain": _buckets, "range": [tiles.color("age_bucket", b) for b in _buckets]},
                  "legend": {"title": "Age", "orient": "top"}},
        "order": {"field": "age_bucket_order"},
        "tooltip": [{"field": "status_label", "title": "Status"}, {"field": "age_bucket", "title": "Age"},
                    {"field": "issue_count", "title": "Issues"}],
    },
})
```

### New issues answered within 48 hours
[By week opened; unanswered issues count as misses]{.tile-subtitle}

```{python}
chart({
    "data": {"values": rows("response_weekly")},
    "mark": {"type": "line", "point": True, "color": tiles.MANIFEST["palette"]["single_series"]},
    "encoding": {
        "x": {"field": "week", "type": "temporal", "title": "Week opened"},
        "y": {"field": "pct_responded_48h", "type": "quantitative", "title": "% answered within 48h",
              "scale": {"domain": [0, 100]}},
        "tooltip": [{"field": "week", "type": "temporal"},
                    {"field": "pct_responded_48h", "title": "% within 48h"},
                    {"field": "issues_opened", "title": "Opened"},
                    {"field": "responded_48h", "title": "Answered in 48h"},
                    {"field": "median_hours_to_first_response", "title": "Median hours to first reply"}],
    },
})
```
